authority_note: Every requirement below is quoted or paraphrased from an official Amazon page, linked in `source_url`. Requirements marked `unverified` could not be read because the official page requires an Associates login.

documents.name: Associates Program Policies (incl. Commission Income Statement, Participation Requirements, IP Licence, Trademark Guidelines, Mobile Application Policy, Agent Terms)
Commission rate card (Standard / Special Commission Income schedule)
documents.note: This URL redirects to an Amazon sign-in. Category rates are only readable from inside an Associates account. No rate is published as a fact on the site.

documents.name: Creator University — Operating Agreement dos and don'ts

disclosure.requirement: State the affiliate relationship clearly and prominently on the site.
disclosure.exact_wording_amazon_supplies: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

disclosure.requirement: The disclosure must be next to the affiliate link, clear and conspicuous, not buried.
disclosure.note: Amazon's own guidance lists approved language including '#paidlink', '#ad', 'CommissionsEarned', or the Associates sentence.

disclosure.requirement: Do not imply Amazon sponsors or endorses the site.
Include the trademark attribution Amazon's own guidance asks for: 'Amazon and the Amazon logo are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates.'
Comply with the US FTC Guides Concerning the Use of Endorsement and Testimonials in Advertising where applicable.

linking_rules.requirement: Every Amazon link must carry the Associate's tracking ID as a URL parameter.
linking_rules.note: No Store ID was supplied. The site therefore does not fabricate a tag. See I-4.

linking_rules.requirement: Links must be accessed directly from the site; no intermediate redirect pages that auto-forward the user.
No cloaking via link shorteners on the site; the supplied link.amazon/* short links are therefore not embedded — the canonical ASIN URL is.
Never bid on 'amazon', 'kindle' or any Amazon mark, including misspellings, in paid search.
linking_rules.note: Applies to any future paid acquisition. The site runs no ads.

linking_rules.requirement: Do not place affiliate links on pages reached from a search engine in a way that disqualifies the purchase; organic search to your own site is fine.
No Amazon mark in a domain name, subdomain, Store ID, username or handle.
linking_rules.note: This site is hosted at kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone2 — no Amazon mark in the host or path.

linking_rules.requirement: Do not post affiliate links on Amazon itself, or link from Amazon to the site to promote links.

pricing_rules.requirement: Show price and availability only if Amazon serves the link that displays them, or if the data comes from Creators API / PA API.
pricing_rules.note: No price is printed on the site. The site links out and says prices change.

pricing_rules.requirement: Any displayed price needs a date/time stamp and the standard 'prices are accurate as of' disclaimer.
pricing_rules.note: Not applicable while no price is displayed; the rule is recorded so that it is applied if prices are ever added.

pricing_rules.requirement: In a price-comparison format, show both the lowest new price and the lowest used price.
pricing_rules.note: No comparison pricing is displayed. Recorded as a constraint for future work.

content_rules.requirement: Do not add to, delete from or alter Program Content; do not misstate product attributes.
Do not cache Product Advertising Content beyond 24 hours; images may not be stored at all. ASINs may be stored indefinitely.
content_rules.note: The site stores ASINs and links only. It hosts no Amazon product images and no Amazon-hosted copy.

content_rules.requirement: Remove Program Content promptly when it is no longer on an Amazon site.
Site must contain original content — significant commentary, analysis or transformation — not just reproduced listings.
No incentivised or compensated reviews; no reviews written in exchange for payment, discounts or free product.
Do not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or misleading claims about any product, price or promotion.
Remove references to limited-time promotions as soon as the promotion ends.
content_rules.note: The site never states a discount or a deal.

automation_rules.requirement: An 'Agent' — any software taking autonomous or semi-autonomous action — must identify itself in the HTTP user agent as 'Agent/[agent name]'.
automation_rules.note: This is the binding constraint on full automation of Amazon data collection.

automation_rules.requirement: An Agent must not conceal that its access is automated, must not mimic human interaction patterns, must not solve or bypass CAPTCHAs, and must not circumvent blocking measures.
Do not use Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models without prior written approval.
Do not use data mining, robots or similar data-gathering and extraction tools on Program Content beyond what the licence allows; use Creators API / PA API instead.
Respect Creators API / PA API rate limits (calls per second) and the 40 KB request limit.

account_rules.requirement: At least three qualifying sales within the first 180 days, after which Amazon reviews the application. Personal orders do not qualify.
Sites need robust original content — Amazon's rule of thumb is at least 10 posts — and must be public and owned by the applicant.
Website content must be recent, generally within the last 60 days.
account_rules.note: Implies a refresh cadence is a compliance requirement, not just an SEO nicety.

account_rules.requirement: Commission is paid approximately 60 days after the end of the month earned.
US payment minimums: direct deposit 10 USD; gift card 10 USD (max 2,000 USD); cheque 100 USD with a 15 USD processing fee.
account_rules.section: Commission Income Statement §6, Payment Minimum Chart

account_rules.requirement: Either party may terminate on 7 days' notice; Amazon may terminate immediately for material breach.
Do not claim commission from both Amazon Associates and another programme on the same traffic.
After 3 years of no substantial activity, accrued commission may be withheld with 7 days' notice.

commission_rates.reason: The official rate card at https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/help/operating/schedule requires an Associates login and could not be read. Amazon's public marketing page states only 'Earn up to 10% in associate commissions'.
commission_rates.public_headline: Earn up to 10% in associate commissions from qualifying purchases and programs.
commission_rates.note: Secondary sources widely report 3% for Home categories in the US, but a secondary source is not an official source, so no category rate is published. Flagged for review.

session_and_attribution.rule: A session lasts until the first of: 24 hours from the click, the customer places a non-digital order, or the customer clicks someone else's Special Link.
A product added to cart can still qualify if ordered within 89 days of the original click.
Qualifying revenue excludes shipping, gift wrap, handling, taxes, service charges, credits, rebates, card fees and bad debt.
Cancelled, returned or refunded orders are disqualified; so are subscription purchases unless the agreement says otherwise, and pre-order products that are not yet listed.
